explanation: The theorem is an rfl-proved simp lemma. It says the coercion of the symm of the continuous linear equiv built from e equals e.symm, so its content lies in the definition of `toContinuousLinearEquiv`. The only related Mathlib lemmas are in the same file: `toContinuousLinearEquiv_symm` (e.symm.toCLE = e.toCLE.symm) and `coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv` (⇑e.toCLE = e). The theorem would follow from these two combined, and neither alone states it, so it is not a single-declaration special case. I found no other declaration with this statement.
